originalAlarm.description: The value written to `&flags` is never used.

presenceCondition: (and (= CROSS_COMPILE false) (= WIN32 false) (= NEED_ENHANCED_ESCAPES true))
model:
(define-fun WIN32 () Bool
  false)
(define-fun NEED_ENHANCED_ESCAPES () Bool
  true)
(define-fun CROSS_COMPILE () Bool
  false)
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: Same file as PRODUCT_36/45/48/66 (c76df14dfb4.c), dead store on 'flags' at line 38 (inside #ifdef NEED_ENHANCED_ESCAPES) when CROSS_COMPILE=false, WIN32=false, NEED_ENHANCED_ESCAPES=true. In the real Apache gen_test_char.c, flags is written to test_char_table on each loop iteration; the simplified file stripped that table write. Simplification artifact. Note: CROSS_COMPILE=false && WIN32=false && NEED_ENHANCED_ESCAPES=true is actually an impossible configuration since NEED_ENHANCED_ESCAPES is only implicitly defined when !CROSS_COMPILE && (WIN32 || OS2). The known vbdb bug is OSCommandInjection when CROSS_COMPILE && WIN32.
